requirements.statement: Keep establishment registration separate from drug listing.
requirements.competency_question: Which subject is registered or listed?
requirements.positive_acceptance: Facility registration and product listing remain distinct.
requirements.negative_acceptance: Registration alone cannot create a product listing.
requirements.decision_reason: Registration and listing have different subjects and facts; no matching prior requirement.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Keep establishment registration separate from drug listing.

requirements.statement: Registration must not imply product approval.
requirements.mapping_gap: Existing authorizationParty targets organizations/facilities; product approval representation unresolved.
requirements.decision_reason: R-DS-06 addresses digital records, not establishment-registration facts.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Registration must not imply product approval.

requirements.statement: NDC listing must not imply approval.
requirements.competency_question: What approval evidence supports this product?
requirements.positive_acceptance: Listed product may have unknown approval.
requirements.negative_acceptance: NDC presence cannot supply approval evidence.
requirements.decision_reason: NDC identification/listing is a distinct insufficient premise from registration and mere record existence.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: NDC listing must not imply approval.

requirements.statement: Attribute submitted directory information to its labeler.
requirements.mapping_gap: Submitter attribution differs from listing responsibility.
requirements.decision_reason: Submitting labeler attribution is not regulatory verification or listing responsibility.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Attribute submitted directory information to its labeler.

requirements.competency_question: What follows from a missing entry?
requirements.negative_acceptance: Do not infer unapproved or nonexistent.
requirements.decision_reason: Source-scoped absence and global negative conclusions were not addressed by the prior 24.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.

requirements.statement: Distinguish marketing dates from retrieval dates.
requirements.competency_question: Was the entry published at the queried time?
requirements.negative_acceptance: Do not equate retrieval with marketing start.
requirements.decision_reason: Marketing validity and retrieval time differ from deployment time and result timestamps.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Distinguish marketing dates from retrieval dates.
requirements.clarification: Date fields support a declared publication-window check, not a promise that the actual directory contains the entry; retrieval time can equal marketing time by coincidence.

requirements.statement: Qualify reporting obligations by actor role and scenario.
requirements.negative_acceptance: Do not generalize one scenario globally.
requirements.decision_reason: R-PV-06 constrains jurisdiction; actor-role and scenario selectors add independent criteria.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Qualify reporting obligations by actor role and scenario.
requirements.clarification: Synthetic applicability profiles are bounded encodings of cited guidance, not a complete legal compliance engine.

requirements.statement: Separate potential-shortage reports from actual shortage situations.
requirements.competency_question: Is this a forecast or actual shortage?
requirements.negative_acceptance: Forecast alone cannot establish actual shortage.
requirements.decision_reason: Potential-shortage content is distinct from an actual situation; PV signal criteria do not establish this.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Separate potential-shortage reports from actual shortage situations.

requirements.statement: Constrain reporting product scope to the selected scenario.
requirements.competency_question: Are CAPs, NAPs or selected medicines in scope?
requirements.negative_acceptance: Do not apply routine CAP scope universally.
requirements.mapping_gap: Authorization route and scenario membership unresolved.
requirements.decision_reason: Product authorization route and action-specific scope are independent selectors.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Constrain reporting product scope to the selected scenario.

requirements.statement: Bind reporting frequency to the announced action.
requirements.competency_question: Which frequency applies to this action?
requirements.negative_acceptance: Do not hard-code a universal interval.
requirements.decision_reason: Action-scoped frequency and version selection are distinct from the existence of a timestamp.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Bind reporting frequency to the announced action.

requirements.statement: Distinguish a generated record from its generating activity.
requirements.negative_acceptance: Do not identify activity with output.
requirements.decision_reason: Fold generation traversal and record/activity separation into R-DS-04; retain B2 alias and source provenance.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Distinguish a generated record from its generating activity.

requirements.statement: Distinguish entity attribution from activity association.
requirements.competency_question: Is responsibility attached to artifact or activity?
requirements.mapping_gap: Agent typing and responsibility mapping pending.
requirements.decision_reason: Artifact attribution and activity association are different responsibilities; neither implies the other.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Distinguish entity attribution from activity association.

requirements.statement: Retain derivation lineage between data artifacts.
requirements.competency_question: Which artifact was this derived from?
requirements.decision_reason: Artifact-to-artifact derivation is not the same relation as record-to-generating-activity.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Retain derivation lineage between data artifacts.

requirements.statement: Represent revision lineage without automatic identity merging.
requirements.positive_acceptance: Keep both versions and revision link.
requirements.negative_acceptance: Revision alone must not assert owl:sameAs.
requirements.decision_reason: R-RM-06 is review ordering and R-DS-02 is component version tracing; artifact revision adds a lineage contract.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Represent revision lineage without automatic identity merging.

requirements.statement: Keep a source record distinct from its represented subject; resolve reporter identity without requiring reporter and organizational subject to differ.
requirements.competency_question: Which organization reported on which establishment?
requirements.positive_acceptance: An organizational subject may report on itself; record identity remains separate.
requirements.negative_acceptance: Reject record-subject identity collision, including known owl:sameAs aliases.
requirements.decision_reason: Separate record from subject; reporter may equal organizational subject. Do not impose pairwise distinctness universally.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Keep registration entity, reporting organization and source record distinct.

requirements.statement: Treat SPL as a submission representation.
requirements.competency_question: Which submission represents the listed drug?
requirements.negative_acceptance: Do not identify payload with physical product.
requirements.decision_reason: SPL payload-to-subject representation differs from component-record identity and subject/reporter resolution.
requirements.desk_review_scope: All prior 24 headings and acceptance criteria plus the other 15 B2 rows; human expert acceptance pending.
requirements.original_statement: Treat SPL as a submission representation.
